findings.claim: The done-flip detector is byte-coupled, not semantic: git log -S '"to": "done"' matches raw blob bytes — the compact spelling '"to":"done"' matches zero commits in real history (verified), a reordered or reformatted record hides its flip, any non-transition occurrence of the literal counts as a flip, and nothing pins the serializer's 2-space format to the fence's pattern

Null flip fails OPEN silently: doneFlipSha swallows git errors into null and citesFinishedWork treats null as in-flight — no committed flip, a swallowed error, or shallow history turns the done-law off with zero output, while the docstring claims a 'visible boundary' and the change deleted the one skip notice that used to exist

The discriminator consults only pusher-rewritable local history: rebasing a post-flip citing commit before the flip (or re-serializing the record) defeats the law at both the local fence and CI; the origin-recency design anchored on state outside the push and was removed

The changed code has zero machine verification: doneFlipSha and citesFinishedWork are unexported and referenced by no test; the four citation cases pass literal booleans through the unchanged seam; inverting the ancestry direction passes every self-test — and the task's pin-exemption asserts 'pinned by the four citation-seam self-test cases', a coverage claim that is false

Shallow clones silently disarm the law: git log -S over a truncated history returns empty with exit 0, so a typical shallow pre-push clone gets the done-citation law off by default; only this repo's CI fetch-depth: 0 saves the CI path, and the doctor certifies wiring, never liveness

Transport and doc drift: citationRefusal's docstring still documents the deleted remote-anchor design; a single commit carrying both code and the done-flip passes the fence but refuses the commit-msg gate; TASK-LIFECYCLE claims history discrimination 'at either transport' while the commit-msg gate is unconditional

The pickaxe runs with default history simplification: in merge-shaped histories the commit that introduced the done string can be pruned from the traversal, dating the flip later than truth and shrinking the refusal window
The self-test banner claims '16 authorization' cases but authCases enumerates 15 — a hand-maintained count wrong on the battery the wave's evidence leans on
